notes.title: HACK.BAK Out Now!
notes.content:
HACK.BAK is now available
Find the commands, traverse the network, and get the key to your precious data.



When I started making this a little over a year ago, I wasn't sure I'd be able to stick with it and release on Steam, but here I am, doing just that.  Thank you to all my friends who helped test the game and my wife for writing the text for many of the extra files you'll find on your path.  An especially big thanks to Captain Lucian for making the music.



If you enjoy this little game of mine, I hope you can share it with someone else who does too.



-David Huish
